# Api

Custom API implementations. Synthetic dv-tools test fixture: the method bodies are left out; dv-tools reads only the declarations.

## Files

- `CalculateBudget.cs`: implements the Custom API dvt_CalculateBudget; not a pipeline entry plug-in, so dv-tools reports it as unknown.

## Trigger points

The Custom API message dvt_CalculateBudget.

## Special assumptions

Outside the pipeline architecture on purpose.
